card.name: Ninja Armado
card.summary: Consulte a descrição completa em português do efeito implementado.

textEvidence.text: Mandatory FLIP trigger, including battle reveal. Select exactly one face-up spell or Set Spell/Trap on either field. Destroy the selected card. A Set target is revealed only on resolution: destroy only a matching spell; otherwise leave it Set in its original position. A Trap inspection cannot select the Field Zone because it cannot hold a Trap. No activation cost, optional decision, once-per-turn restriction, second effect or continuing duration. Activate even with no eligible target; then resolve without an operation. Select at activation, recheck the same target and its lifetime on resolution; never retarget. Negation prevents the operation, but merely removing the source does not negate it.

assertions.containsText: Efeito de Ninja Armado ativado na corrente.
